author: Seung Wook
problem: queue lists (name, weight in kg) for the people waiting for a cable car, in order. People board in queue order until the next person would take the total weight over limit. Return the names of the people who board.
bug_description: Stops when total + weight >= limit instead of > limit, so a person who would bring the car exactly to its limit is left behind.

comments.accurate: People who board in queue order while the car stays within its weight limit
comments.wrong_behavior: People who board in queue order while the load stays below the weight limit
comments.wrong_location: Weight check verified; check boarding stops at the first person who doesn't fit
